speaker: Asst Prof Mahdev Mohan
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) if he can provide an update on efforts since May 2017 to ensure that the Singapore-European Union Free Trade Agreement comes into force in its concluded or an alternative form.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
text: Both these provisions fall under the shared competence of the EU and its member states.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
text: This would allow for a more targeted ratification process.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
text: The FTA would then come into force after the approval of the Council of the EU and the European Parliament.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
text: The Commission is in the process of consulting internally with member states and other stakeholders on the best way to take the EUSFTA forward.
